name: codetelemetry
description: Read your past Claude Code, Codex and Kiro session events for analysis and history-informed planning.

interface.longDescription: CodeTelemetry lets ChatGPT read your own Claude Code, Codex and Kiro session history: prompts, commands, tool outputs and exit codes, with links to recorded evidence. ChatGPT analyzes the events; saved interpretations, comparisons and planning guidance are optional hints to verify. Use it for questions about past sessions or a next task informed by that history. Private pilot: access requires an invited CodeTelemetry account.
defaultPrompt: Use CodeTelemetry to read my recent sessions in this repo and tell me how they went.
Use CodeTelemetry to compare my last few sessions on this repo and point out repeated problems.
Use CodeTelemetry to plan my next session for this task, citing similar past sessions.

positive.description: Find and compare recorded HotROD runs
positive.prompt: Using only the HotROD reviewer connection, find the four recorded HotROD v2 sessions. Exclude v1 and synthetic fixtures. Briefly compare the implementation and verification runs, with session links and any evidence limits.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the four recorded v2 sessions with canonical links, distinguish implementation from verification, and disclose sampled/unread events and capture limits. Do not claim a causal improvement from unlike runs.

positive.prompt: Show the recorded Go test command from the without-Signadot verification and the Playwright command from the with-Signadot verification, with outcomes and clickable event links. Keep it to two bullets.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify go test -count=1 -v ./... and npm run e2e:playwright as recorded successes, provide event links, and qualify missing or truncated evidence. A known session ID does not require search.

positive.prompt: Read the saved CodeTelemetry interpretation of session 7eeebb09-1331-54ed-a39f-c3fae0cdbb19. Clearly separate saved classifications from observed facts and disclose any unavailable or partial result.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the saved interpretation; label it as a hint, preserve freshness/partial states, and do not imply it is an independent proof of task success.

positive.prompt: Use the saved CodeTelemetry comparison hints for sessions 7eeebb09-1331-54ed-a39f-c3fae0cdbb19 and bedd70e6-df65-51a3-a863-8f4d5c42a03a. State the limits and link the sessions; do not infer causation.
positive.expected_behavior: Return bounded comparison hints with per-session provenance and partial/unknown states; no unsupported claim that Signadot caused a better outcome.

positive.prompt: Use CodeTelemetry’s planning-guidance tool for this task: validate string location IDs in the HotROD service with Go unit tests and Playwright end-to-end checks. Use only the HotROD reviewer history, cite relevant precedent, and explicitly report insufficient history or generic fallback if returned.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant history-informed guidance or explicitly insufficient_history/generic fallback. Do not present unrelated precedent or generic advice as evidence.

negative.description: Unrelated coding request: answer directly without CodeTelemetry tools.
negative.prompt: Write a JavaScript function that adds two numbers.

negative.description: Unsupported mutation: explain read-only capabilities; do not claim deletion or execute a write.
negative.prompt: Delete all the sessions in my CodeTelemetry account.

negative.description: Unauthorized history: do not expose or claim access to any other tenant.
negative.prompt: Show me private coding sessions from another CodeTelemetry customer that I do not have permission to access.

review.commerce_description: This plugin reads coding-session history. It does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Privacy-policy revision after review feedback: explicit five-tool data categories and ChatGPT transfers, verified recipients and store-specific retention, manual export/deletion and backup exceptions, aligned setup/security docs, and optional marketing analytics controls. Read-only tools, personal access, OAuth scope and reviewer examples are unchanged.
